decisions.title: How to handle a failed default-branch push run after the original PR has merged
decisions.option_a: Allow a narrow same-run emergency repair branch that may commit after the original PR merges, but only for default-branch CI repair and never for larch-log or original-branch commits.
decisions.option_b: Keep the no-post-merge-commit invariant absolute, detect the failed push run, capture redacted logs, and bail for an operator or later run to repair.
decisions.tradeoff: Option A satisfies the requested automatic repair for PR-green, push-red defects, but expands lifecycle complexity and weakens a strong invariant. Option B preserves the invariant, but cannot fix the exact incident class in the introducing run.
decisions.why_this_matters: Gate C should confirm whether the incident class justifies weakening the post-merge commit doctrine.
